qualitative.note: Fails Gate 1 (Understandability / Outside Verifiability, REJECT). Opaque long-tail US liability and casualty reinsurance reserving with multi-billion-dollar retroactive reserve additions ($3.1B in 2024 alone following $2.0B in 2023) demonstrating that true underwriting profitability and economic risk exposure cannot be verified from the outside by an equity investor.
qualitative.evidence: Swiss Re added $3.1B to prior-year US casualty reserves across the first nine months of 2024 (including a $2.4B charge in Q3 2024) to address social inflation and litigation severity, following $2.0B of reserve strengthening in 2023. These repeated large-scale reserve shocks highlight long-tail casualty reserving opacity under Gate 1(b).
